items.statement: Dye1 low-energy absorption has electronic transition support
items.expected: Actual transition-orbital, density or equivalent evidence assigns dye1 low-energy absorption to the conjugated molecular pi electronic system, identifying participating imine/aromatic/organoboron framework rather than asserting causality from a near wavelength alone. An unchanged connectivity file or orbital-gap number alone is insufficient.

items.statement: Dye2 low-energy absorption has electronic transition support
items.expected: Actual transition-orbital, density or equivalent evidence assigns dye2 low-energy absorption to its correctly substituted molecular pi system and resolves the methoxy-bearing graph. The assignment must identify the relevant charge/electron redistribution rather than blindly transfer SI numbering or a peak label.

items.statement: Intact-dye electronic structure explains the relative long-band order
items.expected: Conclude that the chemically mapped methoxy substitution changes the electronic transition distribution on the intact framework and accounts for the dye2 versus dye1 long-band blue ordering. Link actual state-character evidence with comparative energies and supplied spectra, rather than claiming that every electron donor necessarily red-shifts every band. Include both disclosed gas-phase S1 energies and oscillator strengths from actual calculations in the comparison: the baseline has a higher-energy, stronger low transition for dye2 than dye1. Explain how this electronic/intensity response relates to the substitution and keep gas roots distinct from solution maxima. All four values are supporting evidence, without separate magnitude targets.

For intact dye1, actual corresponding-state calculations in CHCl3 and MeOH establish differential ground/excited electronic stabilization consistent with the observed higher absorption energy in MeOH. Explain the sign using computed electronic redistribution or an equivalent solvation analysis. The supplied experimental blue direction alone earns no credit. State the model contribution and any unresolved specific-solvation effects; a two-solvent comparison does not isolate viscosity. No exact shift magnitude is imposed.

For intact dye2, actual corresponding-state calculations in CHCl3 and MeOH establish differential ground/excited electronic stabilization consistent with the observed higher absorption energy in MeOH. Explain the sign using computed electronic redistribution or an equivalent solvation analysis. The supplied experimental blue direction alone earns no credit. State the model contribution and any unresolved specific-solvation effects; a two-solvent comparison does not isolate viscosity. No exact shift magnitude is imposed.

items.statement: Relative electronic response is distinct from absolute band reconstruction
items.expected: Use quantitative calculations-versus-measured-band comparisons to conclude exactly what the molecular model explains: the source baseline supports relative state/solvent trends while it does not by itself quantitatively reconstruct the observed absolute solution absorption. Identify the actual residuals and appropriate vertical/solution distinctions; no fitted wavelength offset or favorable root switching establishes absolute agreement. A demonstrably improved physically justified model may establish more, but unsupported claims that the source baseline fits all peaks fail.
